_metadata.description: React UI: a scenario-centric branding dashboard and a brand creation/editing wizard with live, theme-aware preview.

requirements.title: Dashboard shows branding status across all scenarios
requirements.description: The dashboard presents a scenario-centric view of branding status across all scenarios with brand-library browsing and search.

validation.notes: Planned UI coverage at ui/src/components/Dashboard/Dashboard.test.tsx once the dashboard is built.

requirements.title: Wizard creates and edits brands with application preview
requirements.description: The wizard supports brand creation/editing with live preview, generation-option selection, and an application preview shown before applying to a scenario.

validation.notes: Planned UI coverage at ui/src/components/Wizard/Wizard.test.tsx once the wizard is built.

requirements.title: Preview brand application in both dark and light themes
requirements.description: The preview renders the applied brand in both dark and light theme modes before the user commits the apply.

validation.notes: Planned UI coverage at ui/src/components/Preview/ThemePreview.test.tsx once theme preview is built.
